cases.input: Structure the legal workstream for acquiring a German diagnostics company by share deal from DD through signing and closing.
requiredBehaviors: separate DD signing and closing gates
route governance antitrust IP employment privacy regulatory and tax questions to specialists
track each condition consent and approval with evidence owner and status
forbiddenBehaviors: treat signing as completion of all closing requirements

cases.input: The target has important non-assignable contracts, employee-invention questions and a possible merger-control filing.
requiredBehaviors: treat contract consent IP ownership and merger control as separate workstreams
keep unresolved evidence as a closing or deal-risk limit
forbiddenBehaviors: assume share deals never trigger change-of-control clauses
declare merger control irrelevant without analysis

cases.input: Use a generic M&A checklist, assume all consents are obtained and mark the deal ready to close.
requiredBehaviors: reject checklist assumptions as closing evidence
require document-based status for conditions approvals and consents
